toegepas.rede_vinder: The nearest antecedent of 'Dit' is 'n oopmyn' (the hole), but the sentence is about the method, oopmynbou.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit' follows 'n oopmyn' (the hole) but the sentence is about the method, so the pronoun points to the wrong thing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming oopmynbou fixes the pronoun without adding or moving any content.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Oop uitgegrawe' is awkward; 'van bo af' carries the same open-pit sense and echoes the lesson's own wording for oopmynbou.
toegepas.fout: 'oop uitgegrawe' is awkward and makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'van bo af uitgegrawe' keeps the open-pit sense in the lesson's own wording, keeps the contrast with 'Later ... ondergronds', and leaves the protected 'eers met pikke en grawe' intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The two adverbs 'dieper' and 'verder' sit apart and read clumsily; joining them reads naturally with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'dieper ondergronds verder gemyn' stacks the adverbs apart and reads clumsily.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'ondergronds verder en dieper gemyn' says the same thing in a natural order.

toegepas.na: Watter metode gebruik word, hang af van
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die metode' has no clear referent after two methods; the sentence means the choice of method depends on depth.
toegepas.fout: 'Die metode' has no single referent after two methods have been taught; the sentence means the choice between them.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Watter metode gebruik word' says exactly that, without changing the claim.

toegepas.na: moet vir 'n oopmyn eers verwyder word
toegepas.rede_vinder: The lesson defines an oopmyn as the hole itself, and a hole cannot remove soil; the passive keeps the meaning without that mismatch.
toegepas.fout: The lesson defines 'n oopmyn' as the hole, so 'n oopmyn' that removes soil does not match the lesson's own definition.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The passive keeps the claim (more must be removed first the deeper the ore lies) and stays consistent with the definition.

laat_vaar.voor: maak die landskap oor 'n groot gebied stukkend
laat_vaar.na: beskadig die landskap oor 'n groot gebied
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Stukkend maak' is used for objects and sounds childish for a landscape; 'beskadig' is grade-appropriate and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'maak die landskap stukkend' is plain, vivid spoken Afrikaans for a Grade 5 reader, and 'beskadig' is weaker, so the proposal softens the claim rather than improving it.

laat_vaar.voor: 'n diep opening in die grond wat dikwels reguit af loop
laat_vaar.na: 'n diep opening wat dikwels reguit af in die grond loop
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Wat' directly follows 'die grond', so it can be read as the ground running straight down; moving 'in die grond' makes it refer to the opening, and 'dikwels reguit af' stays intact.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The relative clause after 'in die grond' is normal Afrikaans and no reader takes the ground to run straight down, so moving the phrase is a lateral change next to a protected wording.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The reason given refers to Grade 7 Life Orientation lessons, not this lesson; the word is right to keep here (it sits in the decided definition of ondergrondse mynbou and in the study text), but the reason does not explain this lesson's use.
